module fifo_10 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input wr_en,
  output full,
  output fault
);

  reg [3:0] count;
  reg sticky_fault;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      count <= 4'd0;
      sticky_fault <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (wr_en && !sticky_fault) begin
        if (count == 4'd9) begin
          sticky_fault <= 1'b1;
          count <= count; // remain full
        end else begin
          count <= count + 1'd1;
        end
      end else if (!wr_en && !sticky_fault) begin
        count <= count; // no change
      end else if (sticky_fault) begin
        // fault is sticky, so remains high
        count <= count;
      end
    end
  end

  assign full = (count == 4'd9);
  assign fault = sticky_fault;

endmodule
